rules_declared_before_scoring: Development data only: headlines with created_at <= 2019-12-31T23:59:59Z (filtered at load, asserted); dev panel harness.load(). Nothing 2020+ opened.

News archive starts 2015-01-01, so scored years are 2016-2019 (4 validation years); training rows for news models start in 2015 (after a 63-session warm-up of the abnormal-count feature). The Amendment 2/3 rule 'positive in >= 5 of 7 years' becomes 'positive in >= 3 of 4 years'. Selection within the branch: highest mean increment over MASTER among configurations positive in >= 3 of 4 years; development gate (phase 2): increment t >= 1.5. Shrunk increment across all logged configurations reported.

Timing: a headline with created_at after 16:00:00 America/New_York on session t (or on a non-session day) belongs to the next session; features at Thursday row t use only headlines assigned to sessions <= t. Unit-tested with planted headlines (test_timing.py).

Missing news is an explicit state: has-news indicators; tone/novelty/multi-share NaN where no headline in the window, ranked features NaN -> 0 (neutral) plus the indicator. Names with no headline in the trailing 126 sessions get abnormal count NaN (no baseline).

Tone: Loughran-McDonald lists are NOT obtainable offline (pysentiment2 not installed, no package index; network fetches forbidden), so tone uses a small documented HAND list of finance words (lexicon.py), labelled as such everywhere. Tone only over single-symbol headlines.

Availability check (as Q7 did for GICS): weekly IC of the pure has-news indicators with y5 on 2016-2019 Thursdays. Covered-subset diagnostic declared for every comparison regardless: candidate and reference both restricted to name-weeks with >= 1 headline in the prior 21 sessions. Rule (as Q7): if a full-panel gain is not matched to at least half on the covered subset, the gain is attributed to the coverage leak and the verdict uses the covered subset.

Size tercile: no market cap in the dev file; proxy = trailing 63-session mean dollar volume (.cache/tree/q6_dv.npz, Yahoo close x volume), terciles across eligible names each Thursday. Increment reported by tercile. Labelled a liquidity proxy.
plan: audit: headlines per name-year (2015-2019), share of eligible name-weeks with any headline in the prior 5/21 sessions by year, names with zero headlines split by priced/unpriced and by still-eligible-at-end-2019 vs left; availability IC of has-news (21-session) and has-archive indicators with y5
timing unit test with planted headlines (15:59 / 16:01 NY on a Thursday, a Saturday headline, a headline on t+1 that must not move row t)

features (build once, .cache/tree/extra_news_dev.npz with note): cnt1, cnt5, cnt21 (log1p), abn21 = log1p(cnt21/21) - log1p(trailing 126-session mean daily count, min 63), abn5 likewise for 5 sessions, novelty5/novelty21 (share of headlines whose normalised text - lowercase, digits and punctuation removed - was not seen for that name in the prior 21 sessions), multi21 (share of headlines with >1 symbol), tone5/tone21 (hand-list (pos-neg)/(pos+neg) per single-symbol headline, averaged; NaN if none), has5, has21 indicators, dsl (sessions since last headline, capped 252); all set NaN off-eligible, cross-sectionally ranked in [-0.5,0.5] per session, NaN -> 0 plus the indicators
c1: fixed blend 0.7 rank(MASTER) + 0.3 rank(tone21), tone missing -> neutral 0.5; no fit; MASTER's names only
c2: Fama-MacBeth: per-Thursday cross-sectional OLS of rank(y5) on [MASTER rank, 13 news features, has21] for training Thursdays >= 2015-04 and <= train_end; mean coefficients; predict MASTER's names

c3: HistGradientBoosting with D_ensembles settings (lr 0.03, 8 leaves, min leaf 400, l2 1, max_features 0.5, trees chosen by rank IC on the last 26 training Thursdays from 50/100/200/400 - 104 is longer than the news training span) on [MASTER rank, news features]; rank target; seeds 0-2; training Thursdays >= 2015-04
ref_D: D_ensembles/model.py trees (27 inputs, 5-session rank target, training from 2009) scored 2016-2019, seeds 0-2: declared control for c4

c4: D trees with the news features appended to the 27 inputs (news = 0, indicators 0, before the archive starts), same settings and seeds; reported vs MASTER and as a paired IC difference vs ref_D (full panel and covered subset)

c5: abnormal attention x 5-day residual reversal (Chan 2003 sign: news-driven moves drift, no-news moves reverse): s = rank(e5) * abn5 (centred ranks), blend 0.7 rank(MASTER) + 0.3 rank(s); names without baseline neutral
c6: tone x novelty: s = rank(tone5) * novelty5-rank shifted to [0,1] (tone of novel news), blend 0.7 rank(MASTER) + 0.3 rank(s); missing neutral

dml: double ML of the best configuration's news component (and of tone21, declared): partially linear, Y = rank y5, T = news score rank, controls = MASTER rank + D's 27 inputs, HGB nuisances cross-fitted by year 2016-2019, NW(4) on weekly sums
